add_fpn_ResNet50_conv5_body: add an FPN feature pyramid network onto a ResNet-50 backbone model for multi-scale feature extraction
add_fpn_ResNet101_conv5_body: add an FPN feature pyramid network onto a ResNet-101 backbone model for multi-scale feature extraction
add_fpn_onto_conv_body: bolt FPN levels onto any convolutional backbone by passing a conv body function and level info
add_fpn_rpn_outputs: add region proposal network outputs with shared weights across all FPN pyramid levels
map_rois_to_fpn_levels: map a set of RoIs to their optimal FPN level using the canonical scale heuristic from the FPN paper
